question.text: Within the Research Analyst grievance framework, complaints can be filed through all the following channels EXCEPT:

answer.text: Direct filing with a foreign securities regulator for domestic RA-client disputes
A physical complaint to SEBI's Office of Investor Assistance and Education or the RAASB grievance email

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook channels RA-client disputes through SEBI-specified dispute resolution and investor complaints through the RA, SCORES 2.0 / RAASB, SMARTODR online conciliation or arbitration, and a physical complaint to SEBI's Office of Investor Assistance and Education or the RAASB grievance email. A foreign securities regulator is not part of this framework. The Trap: All three other options are source-supported domestic channels; only the foreign-regulator option falls outside the RA grievance framework. Note: Courts and consumer forums were not found in the checked pages as part of the RA grievance framework, so they are deliberately not used as a listed channel here.
